content: {"summary":"Emails were about an hour late on 29 June 2026 because the external email provider’s API slowed, increasing send latency and reducing throughput, which built up a backlog despite healthy notification‑worker pods.","likely_cause":"External email provider API slowdown","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The email provider’s API started answering slowly, causing consumer lag to climb.","evidence_ids":["INC-0171#0"],"quote":"the email provider's API starts answering slowly; consumer lag on `notifications.outbound` begins to climb."},{"text":"During the slowdown a send took about 1.6 s, dropping throughput to ~25 msg/s, below the arrival rate and creating backlog.","evidence_ids":["INC-0171#1"],"quote":"During the slowdown a send took about 1.6 s, so throughput fell to 40 / 1.6 = 25 a second"},{"text":"Both notification‑worker pods remained healthy with no restarts during the incident.","evidence_ids":["INC-0171#0"],"quote":"Both pods healthy, no restarts"}],"next_checks":["Monitor external email provider API latency and alert on degradation","Add alerts on consumer lag measured in minutes of traffic rather than fixed message counts","Request a post‑mortem from the email provider for the slowdown","Verify pod health and in‑flight send limits during future slowdowns"]}
